summary: Quashing of FIR under Prevention of Corruption Act; disproportionate assets case; preliminary inquiry not mandatory if secret information reveals cognizable offence; source information report suffices as preliminary inquiry; order by Superintendent of Police under Section 17 PC Act valid; application of mind demonstrated; High Court's quashing under Section 482 CrPC set aside; investigation justified.
legal_provisions_cited: Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988 s.12, s.13(1)(b), s.13(2), s.17
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; impugned judgment of High Court setting aside FIR quashed; investigation directed to proceed.
